# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> 39 Bruach na Gaile, Moyvane presents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a beautifully situated 3-bedroom semi-detached residence within a mature completed cul-de-sac development. Perfectly blending village charm with modern convenience, the property is within effortless walking distance of all local village amenities, including the local primary school, shops, church, welcoming traditional pubs…
